Ten comments

Liam Childs

So far I know, Liz Carroll wrote this wonderful tune for the “childsplay” project of fiddle-maker Bob Childs.

↳ Posted by clormac on April 9th, 2014.

Liam Childs Slip Jig

I found this wonderful recording of Liam Childs Slip Jig on YouTube.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NACU8NPHoVE

The leading line on this page says there are ‘2 recordings of a tune by this name’ but the link shows 2 tunes with different names. I am not sure how this works as I am a newcomer to The Sessions. I am not sure if they are the same tune or not yet. Meanwhile I’ll just enjoy the tune. I really enjoy slip jigs anyway.

↳ Posted by Seamus Brennan on May 5th, 2014.

Re: Liam Childs

It’ll be copyrighted, Roy, but that doesn’t stop you playing it. Since it’s already been recorded you don’t need permission to record it but you’d need to pay copyright before publishing.
